result.reason: The added clause substantially reaches the preferred position: Client owns and receives an irrevocable assignment of deliverables and work product; TrueLink retains the Interface and its own IP; Client receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded or necessary TrueLink IP; Client retains ownership of its content, IP and customer-related data; and joint ownership is excluded. The changes are confined to the identified ownership gap and preserve TrueLink’s existing rights and Credit Data use licence. Drafting is generally professional, though “TrueLink Intellectual Property” should ideally be defined expressly as pre-existing or independently developed IP so the exclusion cannot be read to swallow newly created deliverables, and the references to “TrueLink's Intellectual Property” and “TrueLink Intellectual Property” should be made consistent.
